title: The Quality of Public Expenditure: Social Trade off, Allocations Failure and the Efficiency Government Spending
content: The quality of public expenditure in particular is naturally analysed on this approach, to understand naturally their respective effects on the society, in particular, that are naturally characterized with the majority public policies. Thus, a good quality of public expenditure can naturally drive the Country to have for example high levels of prosperity and social stability in particular, however the inclusive social protection with this evidence naturally are characterized to satisfy and to implement the better conditions to the society. In general this approach shows that, with the weak quality of public expenditure, naturally drives a significant social trade off, in particular, when considering the failure of budgets allocations on these Countries particularly. On the other hand, a bad quality of public expenditure drives naturally the government to significant failure, about how to spend the public money and how this evidence can constitute the highest influences to the societies in particular. Thus, the quality of the main public projects are naturally evidenced. The allocations of the majority public money, show, that's have high levels of inefficiencies, that translates to a weak performance of capacity that are relative with budget efficiency in general. The high social trade off is naturally evidenced in this context. Thus, the main reasons that remain some Countries in bad quality of public expenditure, can be relatively with the existence of the high levels of the overbilling, that majority these government shows, thus, with the high overbilling, on the other hand, the social costs and social trade off in particular are evidenced strongly. Countries such as Angola and Equatorial Guinea, the inexistence of local government as another reason for bad quality of public expenditure, reinforced by the bad impacts of the public expenditure on the inside of region's, naturally. Thus the Impacts of quality expenditure, translate in particular inefficiency on Social protection, where for example with weak social protection the social costs are naturally high. The Angola evidence shows that, continuing increases in overbilling main public projects, on the other hand, decrease the welfare state in particular, where naturally influences with the negatives impacts on the society in general and the social protection are strongly affected, in particular with an significant and considerable decreases on the society in particular.
